executive_summary_brief: Azure-native architecture eliminates integration risk and accelerates onboarding.
Enterprise-grade security: AES-256, TLS 1.3, AAD SSO — all exceeding RFP minimums.
Proven in regulated-industry deployments with zero critical incidents in 12 months.
Teams-native notifications reduce operational overhead for distributed teams.
Competitive per-user SaaS pricing with a fixed-price implementation option.

approved_sections.draft_text:
The [COMPANY_NAME] platform provides enterprise-grade identity management through native Azure Active Directory (AAD) integration, enforcing single sign-on (SSO) for all users via SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect [Ref: P-2025-017]. This approach eliminates password sprawl and ensures that access control is centralised within the client's existing identity infrastructure.

Data security is maintained at every layer: all data at rest is protected using AES-256 encryption with keys managed in Azure Key Vault, and all data in transit is secured with TLS 1.3 and HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) enforcement [Ref: P-2024-009]. This configuration exceeds the minimum encryption standards stipulated in the RFP.

Additionally, the platform delivers real-time operational notifications directly within Microsoft Teams via Adaptive Cards [Ref: P-2025-017], providing the client's teams with immediate visibility into critical events without requiring context-switching to external tools.

Pricing is structured on a transparent per-user, per-month SaaS basis, enabling [CLIENT_NAME] to scale costs directly with adoption. A fixed-price implementation package is available for the initial onboarding phase, providing budget certainty from day one. Volume tiers and multi-year commitment discounts are detailed in Appendix A — Commercial Schedule.
